item.title: From a frozen Telegram photo to the Linux graphics stack
item.description: 1. The fullscreen photo that froze a laptop I opened a photo from Telegram Web in Brave and switched it to fullscreen. The display froze. After failed attempts to recover it, I forced the Framework Laptop to restart. A TTY later showed Vulkan selecting my AMD Radeon 780M. Two warnings about dynamic-buffer limits followed. They looked relevant, but appeared more than ten minutes after the next boot began. The previous boot told a different story.
